digest.component_or_area: LLM review bot retrigger / Gerrit webhook handler
propositions: A contributor-triggered `recheck-review` comment must re-run the LLM review on the current revision when the `-1` vote is a non-finding (coverage-gap, infrastructure veto, or escalated timeout), but refuse if the vote is a real finding BLOCK.

The eligibility gate must read the bot's authoritative current-revision vote message tag from Gerrit durable state (via GET /changes/{id}/messages) rather than trusting the contributor's claim, and parse all three production tag shapes including in-tag merge-change suffixes.

Acceptance of a retrigger must reset the per-revision retry budget (from ticket 0347), enqueue a forced re-review via the existing _rebar_force path, and post a vote-free reply comment (message-only, no labels key).
Refusal of a finding-block retrigger must post a reply explaining the fix path (amend + re-push), emit a RETRIGGER_REFUSED log marker, and touch no vote or budget state.
Comments authored by the bot itself and comments without the `recheck-review` token must be silent no-ops.
The webhook config must subscribe to `comment-added` events; an operator must re-run service-user.sh to activate the trigger by pushing the config to refs/meta/config.
